name: shap
description: FOSS job, labour, quoting, invoicing and bookkeeping for small South African contractors.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c blue,magenta "npm -w @shap/server run dev" "npm -w @shap/web run dev"
scripts.build: npm -w @shap/web run build && npm -w @shap/server run build
scripts.typecheck: npm -w @shap/shared run typecheck && npm -w @shap/server run typecheck && npm -w @shap/web run typecheck
